regressions.issue: _73 and _75 are two reads of mem[64] with only writes to mem[mem[64] + k] between them, but the new text keeps _73 - _75 symbolic, so a custom-error revert becomes raw memory and 8 accesses of the 0xa5b4aa1b string-keyed mapping lose their key.
regressions.rule: A write at mem[p + k] (k >= 32, or a copy starting there) does not change mem[64] unless addresses wrap, which no execution can afford; two reads of mem[64] separated only by such writes are the same value, so p1 - p2 folds to 0.

regressions.issue: Free-memory-pointer values that the old text held in variables (_29, _48, _56...) are now inlined as long sums of ceil32 terms (mixed with the unfolded forms 2 * Mask(250, 5, x + 31) and 96 * ((x + 31) / 32)) at every address: those functions' text doubles (unknown95109d5c 9.7k -> 19.6k chars, unknown49160658 36.5k -> 68k), lines over 200 chars 121 -> 265 in the contract, max line 403 -> 1483 in unknown95109d5c.
regressions.rule: Keep a non-constant free-memory-pointer value (and a value loaded from memory at such an address) in a named variable and write addresses relative to it; normalise Mask(250, 5, x + 31) and 32 * ((x + 31) / 32) to ceil32(x) so equal terms merge.
